answer: A newcomer earns standing by keeping watch at an island lighthouse, logging each zephyr shift — direction, flag colour in umber, and time — witnessed by a neighbour. Two harbour masters verify the log against harbour weather records within five days, checking direction against readings and flag colour against the chart. A copied log, a wind the island never saw, or a missing watch voids the season, burns the 60-credit stake and bars the sponsor a year. One honest season costs 60 credits; a thousand fakes need 1,000 stakes and 1,000 seasons of wind logs, each checked against a real harbour.
